description: unevaluatedProperties of false where the evaluated properties are known without the value: an object's own and those of its allOf branches, inline or through a $ref, at every depth. Each rejects a property that none of them declares.

dynamic.description: An anyOf evaluates the properties of the branches that match, which depends on the value, so unevaluatedProperties is not checked.

refSibling.description: Beside a $ref, which generation follows alone, additionalProperties evaluates every property, so unevaluatedProperties rejects none, and is not checked.

open.description: A branch's additionalProperties evaluates every property, so unevaluatedProperties rejects none, and is not checked.
